group_assessment.weighting: Primary WWOX-group rescue data in two osteosarcoma lines and two mouse routes receive direct experimental weight. Same-group continuity is not replication, and the RUNX2 interpretation is kept below the measurements because RUNX2 itself is not perturbed.

field_density.note: Direct WWOX-RUNX2 and WWOX-osteosarcoma-metastasis intersections are small, so the paper's missing direct RUNX2 perturbation is a material mechanistic boundary.

entries.proposition: Each manipulated osteosarcoma cell line was tested in five mice per arm.
entries.snippet: Five animals were injected with each OS-manipulated cell line.

entries.proposition: The intratibial HOS groups were evaluated at unequal endpoints, limiting a simple time-matched metastasis interpretation.
entries.snippet: Animals were sacrificed at ~3 weeks (for HOS EV tumors) and 5 weeks (for HOS-WWOX tumors).

entries.proposition: The paper's prespecified significance rule is strictly below 0.05.
The intratibial HOS experiment reports macro-metastasis in all EV animals and only micro-metastasis in two of five WWOX animals.
entries.snippet: In fact, all HOS-EV IT-injected mice developed macrometastasis whereas 2 out of 5 (40%) mice injected with HOS-WWOX developed only micrometastasis

entries.proposition: LM7 supplied no intratibial metastasis test because it did not form tumours in the observation period.
entries.snippet: LM-7 cells did not form tumors in the IT model in same time period and therefore WWOX effect on metastatsis using this model could not be assessed.

entries.proposition: The intravenous HOS experiment reports metastasis in all EV animals and micro-metastasis in one of five WWOX animals.
entries.snippet: all mice injected with HOS-EV developed macrometastasis (60%) and micrometastasis (40%) whereas only 1 out of 5 (20%) of mice bearing HOS-WWOX cells in the IV model develop micrometastasis

entries.proposition: The RUNX2 bridge rests on associated transcript changes rather than direct perturbation in this study.
entries.snippet: we found that RUNX2 target genes related to tumor properties are significantly downregulated in HOS-WWOX and LM7-WWOX OS cell lines when compared to the EV cells.

entries.proposition: Figure 1 visually supports reduced wound closure and Matrigel invasion after WWOX restoration in both cell lines.
entries.snippet: Figure 1 panels A-D show WWOX-restoration immunoblots, wound images and lower closure quantification, plus invasion images with HOS-WWOX and LM7-WWOX bars below their EV controls.
entries.anchor: Figure 1 A-D, four of four panels, inspected at 700 by 481 pixels

entries.proposition: Figure 2 separates delayed primary growth from reduced intratibial lung metastasis but its caption does not preserve the unequal sacrifice times stated in Methods.
entries.snippet: Figure 2 panels A-C plot slower HOS-WWOX tibial growth and fewer lung metastases, with p below 0.01 on the metastasis comparison; the raster itself does not resolve the Methods' three-week versus five-week endpoints.
entries.anchor: Figure 2 A-C, three of three panels, inspected at 700 by 214 pixels

entries.proposition: Figure 3 supports reduced intravenous metastasis while exposing the LM7 boundary p-value of exactly 0.05.
entries.snippet: Figure 3 panels A-D show lower HOS and LM7 lung-metastasis counts after WWOX restoration; the HOS comparison is labelled p=0.01 and the LM7 comparison p=0.05.
entries.anchor: Figure 3 A-D, four of four panels, inspected at 700 by 190 pixels

entries.proposition: Figure 4 does not justify a blanket claim that every assayed transcript decreased and provides no visible significance marks or biological replicate count.
entries.snippet: Figure 4 panels A-D display metastasis-gene and RUNX2-target qPCR bars without visible significance symbols; LM7 integrin alpha-2 is not visibly lower in the WWOX bar.
entries.anchor: Figure 4 A-D, four of four panels, inspected at 700 by 456 pixels
